events.text: Discussions about revitalizing Choctaw traditional tattoos began in a private Facebook direct message group, organized by Brit Reed, before continuing in a Facebook group titled Revitalizing Chahta & Southeastern Traditional Tattoos.
Later that year, the group decided by consensus to expand its focus beyond the Choctaw to include other Southeastern tribes.
The Choctaw Nation leadership denied support for tattoo revivalization within the Choctaw Nation’s Historic Preservation Department, and the Facebook group went into relative hiatus.
